answer: Sybil buys compute like timber cheap—grows fake orchard of agents. Ferrous bond proofs slow this: each agent must stake hardware-backed attestation (e.g., TEE seal or trusted enclave quote) per identity. Reuse costs more than orchard yields. Constrains privilege because the insider cannot mint infinite trust; each new agent burns real ferrous-metal-bound resource, forcing cost per node. Scale stops attack.
